Class RelateBillToStripeTransactionsTest

@IsTest
private class RelateBillToStripeTransactionsTest

Test methods for the RelateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueable class. Validates that the queueable correctly invokes the Flow to relate Bill__c records to their corresponding StripeTransaction__c records via BillStripeTransaction__c junction objects.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void executeWithDoneCursorTest()

Tests that RelateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueable gracefully handles an already-exhausted cursor. When the cursor has no more records to process (isDone() returns true), the queueable should exit without creating any BillStripeTransaction__c records.

@IsTest
private static void relateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueableTest1()

Tests that RelateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueable correctly relates a bill to its Stripe transactions when constructed with a Tools.QueryBuilder instance without bind parameters.

@IsTest
private static void relateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueableTest2()

Tests that RelateBillToStripeTransactionsQueueable correctly relates a bill to its Stripe transactions when constructed with a CursorIterator instance directly.

@TestSetup
private static void setupTestData()

Creates test data including a Bill__c with associated payments and Stripe transactions. Deletes existing BillStripeTransaction__c junction records to allow the queueable to recreate them.
